## Coverage of the spec

- Declared by the spec for the implemented resources but **not exposed** (an unsupported method on an exposed path answers 405; an unknown path 404): `DELETE /partyInteraction/{id}`.
- Resources of the spec that are **not implemented**: `/listener` (`/listener/*` is the client's side: hubs subscribe, this service sends).


## Behaviour and deviations

- A `partyInteraction` is one recorded contact with a customer (docs/decisions/care.md):
  `relatedParty` is exactly the customer (role `customer`), `relatedChannel` exactly one
  channel by id (`phone`, `chat`, `email`, `store`, `other`), `direction` `inbound` or
  `outbound`, `status` `open`, `inProgress` or `completed` (the default).
- `interactionItem[].item.entity` is a `Product`, `BillingAccount`, `TroubleTicket` or
  `AuditEntry` (by `@referredType`) of the same customer (422 otherwise). An item keeps `id`,
  `reason`, `resolution`, `interactionItemType`.
- Notes are append-only: the server sets `id`, `author` (the operator) and `date`. PATCH adds
  notes and changes `status`, `description` and `reason`; a completed interaction only takes
  notes (409). `relatedParty`, `relatedChannel`, `interactionItem` and `interactionDate` are
  read-only on PATCH.
- `attachment`, `interactionRelationship` and `externalIdentifier` are 422. DELETE is 405.
- Every interaction logged and every note added writes an account audit entry
  (`/internal/v1/security/audit`).
- Lists filter by `id`, `relatedParty.id`, `product.id`, `billingAccount.id`, `status` and
  `direction`, newest first.

In these notes `::test_name` is a test in the test file named last before it. Hand-written: [`scripts/docs/api-notes/tmf683-party-interaction.md`](../../scripts/docs/api-notes/tmf683-party-interaction.md).


## Errors

Every non-2xx body is the TMF630 `Error`: `{"@type": "Error", "code", "reason", "message", "status"}` (`app/api/errors.py`), also for unknown routes, FastAPI's own validation errors and unhandled exceptions (500 says "internal error" only). Status codes: 400 malformed JSON, unknown or read-only attribute, bad query parameter; 404 unknown id or path; 405 unsupported method; 409 conflict with stored state; 415 wrong content type; 422 well-formed but invalid. 415 and 422 are ours: the TMF specs do not declare them. See [README.md](README.md#conventions).
